translation_notes: NOT-EXPRESSIBLE (query received as data). The queries are the KEYS of self.expanders (dict[str, CompiledExpander]), registered at run time by the steps of the synthesizer (TraverserRegistry.register(query, sweep, traverser)); the region iterates them: `for query, expander in self.expanders.items(): res = self.graph.query(query, initBindings={"node": node})`. s{ } needs its query written LITERALLY at the island site (parsed at transpile time), and m{ } a written pattern: there is no island for "run this query text I was handed", and the queries are heterogeneous (paths, joins, whatever a step declares). The same text is also the dict key of the result (ret[child][query]), so it must remain a string. Minimal excerpt: `res = self.graph.query(query, initBindings={"node": node})` with `query` a loop variable over a runtime dict.

translated.ldpy is therefore identical to original.py (exact transparency, precedent: TDCC-NES askwol _prepare, kglab GPViz.__init__); constructions is empty on purpose. Nothing else in the region is an RDF operation (the rest is dict bookkeeping).

Context shim kindyngen_context.py: CompiledExpander and prepare_query copied verbatim from the repository (the signature annotation of expand names CompiledExpander at def time; kindynsyn is not on PyPI), plus two empty placeholder classes (SweepConfig, Traverser) for the annotations of CompiledExpander.append. Both representations import CompiledExpander from it (one added line).

Driver: self stub with .graph (fixture.ttl) and .expanders (4 real queries: direct, property path, same child through two paths, none matching); nodes a, b, a leaf, an unknown node, and a TreeExpander with no expander. Mutants (initBindings dropped; append dropped) both make the check FAIL.
